wptComparison.scope: fixed WPT-source testharness subset; not a full WPT score
limits: Observed subtest rates never include unknown, unreported subtests; file coverage and union-inventory NOTRUN counts must accompany them.
A full WPT conformance percentage cannot be inferred from this subset.
No candidate report is not a measured zero-percent result.
Browser harness results do not establish visual, media-hardware, or performance parity.
The137 custom Headers checks are separate from the frozen52 upstream Headers variants.
Installed-reference URL quarantine is not lifted by a passing selected subset.
No fresh native CPU/RSS/soak or same-device IPA execution is inferred.
Legacy multibyte streaming and fatal legacy streaming explicitly throw unsupported TypeError; successful UTF8/UTF16 streaming does not retain chunk history.
The current Encoding algorithm preserves unread bytes after fatal streaming errors; observed Node behavior differs and narrow browser diagnostics stay separate.
